audit_items.proof_trace: The P2P RPC handler blobSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler lacks epoch-based deprecation logic for post-Fulu blob requests. While the HTTP API PublishBlobs (line 224) correctly rejects blob sidecars when scEpoch > FuluForkEpoch, the P2P handler only validates against the retention window (MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS) via BlobRPCMinValidSlot, which does not consider FULU_FORK_EPOCH at all. After Fulu activation, peers can still request and receive blob sidecars via P2P even though the protocol should have fully migrated to data columns.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker exploits the asymmetry between API deprecation (enforced) and P2P deprecation (absent). After current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS, the attacker sends BlobSidecarsByRange P2P requests for slots within the retention window but after Fulu activation. The handler processes these requests normally and returns blob data that should no longer be served, wasting bandwidth and storage resources while violating the protocol upgrade path to data columns.
